originalTitle: S&P 500 Target: Wall Street Split On How The Benchmark Index Will Move In 2027
summary: JPMorgan and Deutsche Bank see different trajectories for the S&P 500 amid the AI boom and earnings growth.
content: JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists have a 2027 target of 8,200 points for the S&P 500, well below the consensus estimate of 8,471 points.Deutsche Bank’s equity analysts project nearly 25% upside in the S&P 500 from current levels to 9,000 points by the end of 2027. Jurrien Timmer, Director of Global Macro at Fidelity Investments, believes that markets have already reached peak earnings growth and the question now is how much it will deteriorate.Wall Street has seen a volatile year so far in 2026, with equities oscillating widely amid the ongoing war between the U.S. and Iran, fluctuating oil prices, uncertainty in the AI trade, and inflation concerns. For 2027, however, JPMorgan and Deutsche Bank see different trajectories for the S&P 500, with the former providing a below-consensus target for the benchmark index, while the latter sees it jump to 9,000 points by the end of the year. What’s In Store For The S&P 500 In 2027?According to a report from Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists said that while U.S. stocks are set to advance through the end of 2027, with AI remaining a driving force behind earnings growth, it sees a target of 8,200 points. This is below consensus estimates of 8,471 points, according to Bloomberg data, and also significantly below the 8,700 targets from Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs Group Inc.The firm said that a recent sell-off in the AI sector has pushed the benchmark index into a technical correction, and a 14% upside from current levels seems justified amid deteriorating market sentiment. “While the backdrop appears bleak for equities with a widening gap between perception and reality, we remain of the view that the AI supercycle remains intact with demand for compute still strong and sticky,” the analyst reportedly said in a note on Tuesday. However, Deutsche Bank’s equity analysts are much more optimistic, projecting nearly 25% upside in the S&P 500 from current levels to 9,000 points by the end of 2027. The target is among the highest on Wall Street, driven by strong earnings growth and a revival of the AI investment theme. The bank also noted that the target is unlikely to be affected by the recent market turmoil linked to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.The firm said the ongoing AI boom drove massive earnings growth in 2026, which is likely to extend into the next year, alongside broader growth in sectors beyond technology.“For historical precedent, we see parallels with the early 1960s, which saw many domestic political and geopolitical developments and shocks create pullbacks, but equity prices remained tied to rising earnings,” Jim Reid, the bank’s global head of macro and thematic research, reportedly told Barron's. Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer Says Markets Have Reached Peak Earnings GrowthHowever, Jurrien Timmer, Director of Global Macro at Fidelity Investments, believes that markets have already reached peak earnings growth and the question now is how much it will deteriorate. In a post on LinkedIn, Timmer said investors are unlikely to keep paying for those lofty earnings estimates for three reasons. “One, investors usually don’t pay peak multiples for peak earnings growth. Earnings are cyclical, after all. Second, with cashflows being spent on capex instead of buybacks, investors have less to show for those earnings in the form of a robust payout ratio. And third, financial conditions are inversely correlated to P/E multiples, and those conditions have been tightening as both short and long yields remain in uptrends, the dollar is bid, and credit spreads have widened," he said. Timmer also highlighted that “there is little doubt that we have reached peak earnings growth,” noting that the market can perform fine after a peak in the second derivative, but the key question remains how much the growth rate decelerates from here."The current valuation multiples are indeed a deal. But history suggests that once the peak is in, the growth return returns to a more normal pace (7%). This tells me that earnings estimate revisions will be a key driver as we head into 2027," he said. How Are Markets Reacting?U.S. benchmark indexes were mixed on Tuesday following a sharp rally on Monday after Huang’s return to Nvidia. At the time of writing, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY), which tracks the S&P 500 index, fell 0.58% overnight. Retail sentiment on Stocktwits was ‘bearish’ at the time of writing. The Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) declined about 0.85% amid ‘bullish’ sentiment. The SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust (DIA) also declined by 0.40% in the overnight session, with sentiment in ‘bearish’ territory.Meanwhile, the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) was up 0.22% amid ‘neutral’ sentiment. chineseTitle: 标准普尔 500 指数目标：华尔街对 2027 年基准指数将如何走势存在分歧
chineseSummary: 在人工智能繁荣和盈利增长的背景下，摩根大通和德意志银行认为标准普尔 500 指数呈现不同的轨迹。
chineseContent: 摩根大通策略师将标准普尔 500 指数 2027 年目标定为 8,200 点，远低于市场普遍预期的 8,471 点。德意志银行股票分析师预计，到 2027 年底，标准普尔 500 指数将较目前水平上涨近 25%，达到 9,000 点。富达投资全球宏观总监 Jurrien Timmer 认为市场已经达到了盈利增长的峰值，现在的问题是它会恶化到什么程度。 2026年迄今为止，华尔街经历了动荡的一年，在美国和伊朗之间持续的战争、油价波动、人工智能贸易的不确定性以及通胀担忧的背景下，股市大幅波动。然而，对于 2027 年，摩根大通和德意志银行对标普 500 指数的走势有不同的看法，前者为基准指数提供了低于共识的目标，而后者则认为该指数到年底将跃升至 9,000 点。 2027 年标普 500 指数将何去何从？据彭博社报道，摩根大通策略师表示，尽管美国股市将在 2027 年底前上涨，但人工智能仍然是盈利增长的驱动力，但其目标是 8,200 点。根据彭博社的数据，这低于市场普遍预期的 8,471 点，也远低于摩根士丹利和高盛集团的 8,700 点目标。该公司表示，人工智能行业最近的抛售已推动基准指数进行技术调整，在市场情绪恶化的情况下，较当前水平上涨 14% 似乎是合理的。据报道，这位分析师在 Tu 的一份报告中表示：“虽然股市的背景显得黯淡，感知与现实之间的差距不断扩大，但我们仍然认为人工智能超级周期仍然完好无损，对计算的需求仍然强劲且粘性。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
